summary: Teaches navigating the Cost Management and Billing app to identify cost drivers, view attributions and invoices, and create a usage alert.

needs.description: Cost Management and Billing app (/a/grafana-cmab-app) with usage, attributions, invoices, usage-alerts pages.
Stack/org with active billable usage so Product Breakdown and Monthly Usage render.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "A Grafana Cloud account with active usage"

needs.description: Roles: Billing and usage reader, Usage alerts admin, Cost attribution reader, Invoice reader (or org admin).
Cost attribution labels configured to show attribution data (milestone says data appears only after configuration).
needs.evidence: attributions: "Attribution data appears only after someone configures cost attribution labels"

needs.description: Billing history/invoices (paid org); highlight of "Export usage data" button requires the invoices page to render.
needs.evidence: invoices: "a new or trial account may show few or no invoices"

needs.description: A contact point selectable in the usage alert builder.

reviewNotes: Depends on org-level billing, which may not be available on a docsteam stack in same form (enterprise/invoiced account). Creating usage alerts mutates org settings.
